en: All right.  It'd be nice to find a continuation of that diary.
Huh?
There's something under the bed.

note: sfx: rummage, rummage

en: What's this?
This is it!  The diary!
Let's go ahead and read it.

note: diary date heading (guide 'January 15th:' label)
diary text (guide 951, not a speaker line): I wonder how much time has passed since we fled from Russia.  I don't regret having fled in and of itself.  And yet....
diary date heading (guide 'January 21st:' label)
diary text (guide 953, not a speaker line): My wife and daughter are suffering in bed again today.
diary text (guide 953, not a speaker line): The wounds inflicted upon them by monsters during our escape aren't healing properly.
diary date heading (guide 'January 27th:' label)
diary text (guide 956, not a speaker line): Oh, my dearest wife!  And Anya!  My adorable daughter!  Why did you two have to die?  Just when we had finally arrived in our safe haven at last.

en: Eh?  What is this all about?  What are you talking about, Father?!
Anya?  Who's that?  And, what do you mean, dead?
Oh come on!  This baloney isn't making any sense!
Hmph.  Well.  I won't learn anything by whining about it.  I gotta try reading further.

note: diary text (guide 966, not a speaker line): I can never forgive the monsters for what they've taken from me.  Their days are numbered and I will bring them down.  To that end, I must complete this research!

en: F-father....

note: diary date heading (guide 'February 21st:' label)
diary text (guide 972, not a speaker line): Is my research something that defies the gods?
diary text (guide 972, not a speaker line): Will the serial failures keep piling up one after the next?
diary date heading (guide 'March 7th:' label)
diary text (guide 974, not a speaker line): This latest experiment was another failure.  But I won't give up.  Like hell I would!
diary text (guide 974, not a speaker line): I don't want there to be any more bereaved people like me out there.
diary text (guide 974, not a speaker line): I cannot quit here.
diary date heading (guide 'March 29th:' label)
diary text (guide 977, not a speaker line): The state of the city just keeps on deteriorating.  I mustn't let things continue this way!
diary text (guide 977, not a speaker line): I've got to hurry up and finish the genomroid, even one day sooner!

en: Genomroid?!  So that's what he was researching?
Okay, Father, what on Earth did you do?
Oh?
Gyah!!
Miss.  You've been in here?
Lu-lucille?!
Myyy, my.  What a well-mannered young lady we have here.
While the professor's life hangs in the balance, you mean to tell me that young Miss is up here goofing off?
In no way am I goofing off!
Ohhh, the poor professor, abandoned by his beloved daughter...
Hey!  Listen to what I'm saying!
All alone in his final hours, needlessly falling prey to hungry monsters...  Ohhh, how cruel life can be.
Fine!  I get it.  I'm going back down right now!  That good enough for you?!
I didn't say you had to.
Forsaking the professor and living out life on your own is also an option.
I wouldn't do something like that!  I'm definitely going to save Father; you'll see!
In that case you had best make haste.  Although you're probably already too late.  Fufufu, fufufufu. Keekkekekeke.
Sheesh!  Lucille, you are such an unpleasant louse!
In fact, you go beyond just being mean; you're truly toxic.  A toxi-maid!
However, she does have a point that I needn't be so carefree.  I gotta get back to the labyrinth.

note: sfx: Knock knock, knock knock knock

en: Good morning, Father! It's time to wake up!
